known_orphans.finding: ltx_layout_runs has no product caller; layout uses only ltx_break_utf8. text-transform, spacing and indent cstyle fields do not reach this formatter.
writing_mode is converted but layout/paint do not consume it; direction only reaches the grid RTL setting.
Element scroll offsets stay in a CSSOM side table; paint/layout never consume the offsets. The window scroll callback is a separate wired path.
showPopover updates a JS Map/topLayer array; native top_layer/layout/paint do not consume that state.
WAAPI play sets hold/state; the computed-style JS overlay is not native style/paint. The distinct CSS animation clock is wired.

semantic_gaps: Ordinary fixed/sticky positioning remains incomplete; the separately wired modal viewport path does not establish it.
Pseudo getComputedStyle targeting and complete media-query syntax/listener semantics are outside this audit.
runtime_evidence: Run feature host gates and ordinary guest fixtures separately. This tool never marks a feature rendered.
